reviews_h2: What people say after we are done

reviews.author: Alex Tischler
reviews.text: I have been going to Bridgewater Motorworks for various automotive issues for quite a few years. All I can say is if you are looking for honest people that consistently do high quality work, then look no further. They kept my 2009 Nissan Frontier running way longer than it probably should have. After the dealership told me I needed a new compressor for the A/C, I took it to Bridgewater and they told me it was a 75 cent valve that they weren’t even going to charge me for. Instead I paid a small charge to recharge the Freon and the A/C worked great until I got rid of the truck earlier this year. Recently, I brought my new (ish) 2023 CRV Hybrid in for a leak in my tire and they had it plugged and me out the door in 20 mins for a very reasonable price. If anyone ever asks me if I know a reliable mechanic, my first answer is always Bridgewater Motorworks. Thanks again for the good work guys, I’ll certainly be back. (But hopefully not too soon!)

reviews.author: GG Magnaye
reviews.text: Our family has been going to Bridgewater Motorworks for many, many years now. We’ve always received great service from them. But this last service was just over and above what I expected. My check engine light had been going on and off for a while. I don’t know why I tried different mechanics who couldn’t fix it properly. I finally went back to Bridgewater Motorworks who diagnosed it as a timing chain issue and estimated the very expensive work that needed to be done. I was obviously in shock at the cost and couldn’t decide then. They were very understanding though. When I finally decided to get the work done I had to leave my car with them for 3 weeks as we were going on vacation. When I spoke to Paul after getting back, he quickly mentioned that the problem was not as extensive as they initially thought and they were only doing the necessary work to get it back in proper running order, thereby saving me $$$$! They ran tests to make sure everything was in well and even asked to keep the car another day so they do a final cold start test. In doing the work, they damaged my condenser which they replaced for free. So yes, I’m completely pleased with the work that Bridgewater Motorworks performed on my car. Paul kept me posted on their progress and always patiently answered any questions I had. Clearly, my experience shows that they’re competent, experienced, reliable and most importantly, honest. I am very happy to recommend them.

reviews.author: Brandon Zarin
reviews.text: Paul and the team at Bridgewater Motorworks were amazing. I got into an unfortunate situation on the way to a client’s house where I hit a curb while driving which resulted in 2 flat tires. I got it towed to the shop and they had 2 new tires on that same day. Service was great. Team was great.

reviews.author: Bing
reviews.text: Treats client with respect. I believe they were very fair in their assessment of the problems. My car runs smoothly now. They repair what can be repaired. Provided transportation to and from my place when my car had to stay overnight for the needed diagnostics and repairs. I am happy to recommend them to others who need car service and maintenance.

reviews.author: Chris Porter
reviews.text: Phenomenal - friendly, honest, and skilled motor technicians. Every time I've brought a vehicle here they have excelled - keeping us informed of progress, flexible in pickup and drop off times, quality of work done. They are very familiar with vehicle maintenance and provide advice and suggestions without being pushy - it really feels like they always have you and your vehicle in mind. We have trusted them for routine maintenance, new tires, A/C work, transfer gearbox and transmission, and ABS/brakes. Even tire patching and replacement on EVs! Superb.

reviews.author: Jennifer Ferris
reviews.text: My parents love them and I understand why! I was visiting from out of town and Bridgewater Motorworks accommodated me for a last-minute oil change/maintenance appointment. I was impressed by their honesty - I was told that since they were able to get the work done quicker than expected, I’d be charged less than the estimate. They even replaced my key fob battery! I think I’m going to start planning car maintenance around family visits now :)

reviews.author: Chris Bontempo
reviews.text: Needed a front break replacement so I decided to give them a try. Staff were friendly and offered to look things over before deciding. Ultimately went with the replacement. Service was done fast and pricing was fair and cheaper than what the dealer had originally quoted me on. I’ll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Pat Kibby
reviews.text: I always bring my car to Bridgewater Motor Works for repairs. They always come through with decent pricing and great repairs. I just had an alignment done on Friday, then drove my car approximately four hundred miles this weekend and it drove straight as an arrow! Thank you BMW as always!

reviews.author: Brent Wright
reviews.text: The team did a great job diagnosing my problem and quoted a price to repair. They called when completed and said they needed to adjust the price. My first thought was, here we go. They then said it took them less time than they thought and lowered the price. I can count on one finger how many times I’ve had that happen at a car repair shop. Truck has been running great since

reviews.author: Joseph Del Duca
reviews.text: This is my second five star review for Bridgewater Motorworks, as my family was packing up at the hospital with our newborn son, I noticed a screw in our tire and very low tire pressure. Not wanting to deal with a flat, I called Bridgewater motorworks fifteen minutes before closing time and T (awesome guy!!) told us to come down to get it taken care of with no hesitation. Thank you is much guys, no one wants to deal with this kind of problem with all the activity at home.

reviews.author: Joel Martinez
reviews.text: Excellent service! Got my brake pads and rotors replaced, as well as my rear drums cleaned and adjusted. I received prompt updates and everyone involved was very kind and helpful. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Vijay Motwani
reviews.text: This was my first visit to Bridgewater Motorworks and i had a great experience. I had an issue with my car’s headlight , which was fixed in a jiffy and the price was also quite reasonable. Very prompt service and the team there was also very warm and courteous. Definitely going to visit again.

reviews.author: Nora Sullivan
reviews.text: I just had such a wonderful experience here! I had car trouble and they were the closest auto repair shop, so I stopped by and within an hour (even though they were busy) they had resolved the issue and I wasn’t charged a dime. They were honest, kind, and efficient! I don’t live close by but I would go out of my way to come back here.

reviews.author: Karen Wilkinson
reviews.text: From the moment I walked in I knew I found a gem! Warm and welcoming, professional and knowledgeable. They handled my situation perfectly from start to finish. I highly recommend this business for all your automotive needs.

reviews.author: Sarah Arnold
reviews.text: In the 10 years I have lived in NJ, this is the only place I’ll bring my cars! I found them completely accidentally and I’m so happy I did. From the first interaction 10 years ago, to present day - they’re outstanding. Customer service is second to none, the work is always done correctly the first time, they are great w diagnostics and will never steer you wrong! A true family staple - they’re a household name.

reviews.author: Michael Booker
reviews.text: Check engine light came on with the break light blinking. I drive by Motorworks daily and pulled in. Busy place but diagnostics were done promptly, the rep explained what was needed and why. The sensor was ordered. Even gave me a lift back to my apartment. Job was completed on time. Fair price and great customer service.

reviews.author: Ryan Hoffman
reviews.text: Always a pleasure working with this shop! I usually go here for oil changes, but I’ve also used them to help me install aftermarket wheels and tires on my cars over the years.

reviews.author: Christina Sarles
reviews.text: Extremely professional and transparent. Replaced my engine in a short period of time and with great support and communication. Excellent establishment. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Michael McNulty
reviews.text: Best Mechanics in the Business!! The Team at Bridgewater Motorworks are helpful and knowledgeable but it’s the A++ Customer Service that keeps me coming back. They are honest, polite, and accommodating especially in emergency situations. They provide excellent service for s fair price!

reviews.author: Rohit Mehta
reviews.text: Had a battery issue with my AMG after installing an aftermarket screen, team diagnosed the issue quickly (faulty battery) and replaced in 30-45 minutes tops. Took me in for a quick visit with 1 days notice which is unheard of vs the manufacturer service centers. Highly recommend the shop.

reviews.author: Dan Kasman
reviews.text: The crew over at Bridgewater Motorworks is fantastic! Their communication was amazing and the entire experience was pleasurable. They’re have earned a lifelong client with me and I would recommend them to anyone else who needs a mechanic they can trust

reviews.author: Sean Maurer
reviews.text: Got a flat the other night and had my car towed here. Spoke to T and Paul yesterday and they were incredibly responsive and patient with my questions. They got the tires I requested no questions asked. Will definitely be going back here in the future if my car is damaged again!

reviews.author: Jennifer Clark
reviews.text: Love this mechanic! They work on Mini Coopers, which is unusual, and are very trustworthy. I trust their advice completely. Great customer service, no high pressure tactics and a comfortable waiting room!

reviews.author: Jeremiah Fleming
reviews.text: Been a customer of Bridgewater Motorworks since 2006. They are honest people and good mechanics. I am religious about oil changes and the prepaid discounted program they offer is amazing considering how much I drive. I’ll be back in a few weeks for my next oil change, Keep it up guys!

reviews.author: debra davis
reviews.text: Made an appointment one day before service, within 15 minutes of arrival my car was in the bay. Not only did my oil change go very smoothly they did multiple routine checks and I also requested a few additional checks. My car was also vacuumed. All within the window I was provided for completion.

reviews.author: John Kean III
reviews.text: We have been so happy with each service we have received from Bridgewater Motorworks. They are so friendly and professional, and honest! I will never take my truck back to the dealer for service after my experiences here. And they also really appreciate their customers. The bag of popcorn in my cup holder that said “thanks for popping in” was such a cute and appreciated detail!

reviews.author: Lawns and Beyond LLC
reviews.text: We use Bridgewater Motorworks for all of our company and personal vehicles. This is hands down the best service we have ever had at an automotive shop. We trust and highly recommend using them.

reviews.author: Mohamed Mostafa
reviews.text: I paid $223 for a check engine light and a hard check in my vehicle when I accelerate, just to leave the shop with same issues popping up again and I go back to say it wasn’t fixed and the guy tells me other works need to be done that are over $1000!!

reviews.author: David Nolan
reviews.text: I’ve been using Bridgewater Motorworks for all my company and personal vehicles (24/7 Prestige Transportation) and they do excellent work! Fair pricing , immediate availability when needed and very trust worthy. Paul, Thelonias and rest of the team do an excellent job!!

reviews.author: Ashleigh Brady
reviews.text: Consistently great experience with Bridgewater Motorworks. Honest, fair team and the only ones I trust to take care of my older car. Everyone is incredibly friendly and I fully trust their advice and work.

reviews.author: Xavier Texidor
reviews.text: Final currently deployed. Times is rough right now. Bridgewater Motorworks completely fixed my BMW as I’ve been gone and held great communication. Unfortunately I am not home yet to see the car. But my family sent me pictures and videos and it sounds like brand new! Which I am so grateful!. Thank you. I can’t wait to go home and drive it and test it out.

reviews.author: Ashley Saha
reviews.text: The BEST and easiest oil change I have ever had. They were so friendly professional and fast I will not go anywhere else from now on. Literally 20 minutes total time in shop and they were lovely!

reviews.author: Carly Mac Manus
reviews.text: Paul, Greg, and the entire Bridgewater Motor Works team are truly the best! They consistently go above and beyond to resolve any car issues quickly and efficiently. I highly recommend them to anyone in need of reliable local auto repair!

reviews.author: Christian Henriksen
reviews.text: Friendly and knowledgeable mechanic helped me with a pre-purchase inspection. They also went the extra mile spending extra time trying to check the battery health on my Prius, but they ultimately couldn't (so they get points for doing their best but a minus for not being able to check the hybrid battery when the front desk lady said that they would be able to...)

reviews.author: Joe Hydro
reviews.text: Very helpful staff. Received some maintenance on my vehicle in a timely fashion. They also gave me an excellent list of work needed as a note on my receipt. Most would think this is an upsell. In my case I was aware of these issues already, so it was nice to see how attentive they were to my vehicle. I will be back for future work thanks.

reviews.author: Thomas Duffy
reviews.text: Quick and affordable oil change. Car felt much better. The team also fixed a dead car key that I hadn’t even mentioned. Seems like they go the extra mile. This was my first time in, will be returning for sure.

reviews.author: Ashley Saha
reviews.text: These guys are the best. Honest, friendly, thorough and I have literally never had a bad experience here!!

reviews.author: Sonja Chartowich
reviews.text: The whole staff at Bridgewater Motorworks is super friendly. They are not your typical mechanics. They check your vehicle and make you aware of items needs but don't pressure you to fix them asap unless it's really crucial. I trust them with my vehicles and would recommend them to all my friends and family.

reviews.author: Prasad Vavilala
reviews.text: These guys are amazing. My car had check engine light on for couple of days. I went to a different car mechanic and he said it’s timing issue and cannot be fixed until next week. Bridgewater Motorworks took my car in and diagnosed while dropping me at my home and paul had a hunch it’s just oil change and it is. I got my car by evening. Reasonable prices. Thanks.

reviews.author: David MacLean
reviews.text: I am so pleased with the service, expertise & professionalism at Bridgewater Motor Works. I would not bring my beautiful classic Mercedes anywhere else. It is a low mileage original 50 plus year old vehicle that they maintain as if it just rolled off the showroom floor. Sometimes acquiring the specific part is challenging but they are determined to complete the task as the factory would do in Germany. Due to the fact that it is never driven in rain or inclement weather, they even have kept the car inside this winter until the roads are once again clear & salt free since it took great effort to locate a much needed part over an extended period of time. Where could you find such care & consideration? They are a first class operation & I am so grateful to have found them. They make ownership of a classic ride possible. Two thumbs up!!!

reviews.author: Meredith Burke
reviews.text: Had a tire emergency 4:30 pm the day before Christmas Eve. pulled in. Took me right away, removed the nail in my tire and plugged it in less than 20 minutes for a very reasonable fee. So friendly and helpful. I would come back again in a heartbeat. Thank you and Merry Christmas

reviews.author: Barbara P
reviews.text: Very happy with the service I receive every time I am at Bridgewater Motorworks. Everyone is very professional. They recently replaced my rear brakes and gave me a 3 year/or 36,000 mile warranty. Everything seems to be working fine. I depend on their great work and fair pricing.

reviews.author: Joey Del Duca
reviews.text: Bridgewater Motorworks recently replaced both headlights in my wife's Jeep Grand Cherokee (anyone who knows what's entailed when switching the headlights on that vehicle can understand why it took both headlights to go out before we had them replaced by a professional). I went to Bridgewater Motorworks and they had the bulbs swapped out in record time and at a price that can't be beat. Kudos to Paul and the rest of the staff for their excellent customer service and overall professionalism. Will be going back to Bridgewater Motorworks for all our auto needs such as oil changes, etc. Thanks guys, see you soon!

reviews.author: Andrea O'Brien
reviews.text: We have used Bridgewater Motorworks on a regular basis for a variety of services over the years. Most recently for a punctured tire. They were able to plug the hole immediately upon arriving and had us in and out in under 20 minutes. They are friendly and their prices are more than fair and affordable. Their work is great and reliable. The staff that works there is helpful, understanding, and they are upfront and give a truly honest assessment of work or repair that needs to be completed. They also are able to and consistently complete the work in the estimated time frame stated if not sooner. We would recommend them to anyone for any car repair or maintenance needs.

reviews.author: therese sinko
reviews.text: I recently had a front brake job done here. The job was done quickly and the brakes are great. The folks at the shop are super nice and accommodating. They even dropped me off at home while they did the job!! Definitely my “go to” guys!!!

reviews.author: Pamela Bogart
reviews.text: I recently stopped in for an oil change and tire rotation and was greeted by the most adorable well behaved pup! They helped me identify some issues I have been neglecting and got it all fixed up quickly while I had some great coffee and enjoyed some dog snuggles! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Gina G
reviews.text: My father had work done on his truck multiple times at this location. He was recently having trouble with the air conditioning and they were able to put in whole new unit. The truck is new running and cooling well. He was very satisfied and would highly recommend this business.

reviews.author: Lisa Hilling
reviews.text: Paul and team are always friendly. I never get pushed to do any additional work. I feel their pricing is very fair. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Matt inclair
reviews.text: Service was fast. They got me in right away and had me done in under 30 mins. Only negative is that $58 is a bit much to have a tire mounted and balanced on a wheel already off the car and ready for a tire.

reviews.author: Joseph Rosenello
reviews.text: The staff at Bridgewater Motorworks are very friendly and quick with communication. The shop seems very professional, and they probably do great work. However, their pricing leaves a lot to be desired. They will not give you a job quote until you pay a $190 "diagnostic fee." I already knew what the issue was and the approximate repair cost for the parts + local labor rates. I explained the issue in detail to a mechanic over the phone. The diagnostic fee did not bother me since I had reasonable pricing expectations going in, and I was told the fee would be waved once the work was done. However, they quoted a price significantly over the approximate rates. I had no choice but to take my car back and eat the diag fee in the process. Echoing the sentiments of a few other reviews on here, hiding these extremely high prices behind a diagnostic fee is not fair to anyone. I would have liked to keep Bridgewater Motorworks as my go-to mechanic for my cars, but this questionable practice and abnormal pricing has caused me to look elsewhere.

reviews.author: callmekoffi
reviews.text: I've been getting my car serviced at Bridgewater Motorworks since 2016 and I will never take it anywhere else. The staff is courteous and knowledgeable and make you aware of any issues that arise when looking after your vehicle. If you choose to be a customer just know that you are in the best of hands

reviews.author: Philip Copeland
reviews.text: I'm very pleased with these guys. I brought my truck in yesterday when it started shuddering while driving down the road. They were quick to identify the problem -- a failing coil pack -- and had the truck back to me the next morning. Friendly, polite, no hassle.

reviews.author: Mel Lyons
reviews.text: I had went to Pepboys down the road and was recommended to go here for my headlight that needed a bulb replacement. Called to make sure they could take me less than 30 mins later my car was finished and ready to go. Was very happy with my experience.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Polo
reviews.text: Not your typical mechanic shop! Get ready for a red carpet experience. I was there for an oil change and it was just a wonderful experience. They were quick and made me feel so comfortable. They are detailed, honest and professional. I am totally recommending Bridgewater Motorworks to all of my friends and family. I finally found my shop! Thank you

reviews.author: Cynthia Duh
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable about diagnosing my car once driven by staff. I was immediately contacted and provided a plan on how to best manage the situation. The car works was completed in a timely manner and I did not loose work time.

reviews.author: Beth Phillips
reviews.text: I have been using Bridgewater Motor Works for years. I also had my adult children take their cars there. They are honest and fairly priced. If they don’t have what you need, like rims and tires for my daughter’s car, they told me where to get them and then they mounted them. Always able to get me in.

reviews.author: Phillip Barrood, Esq.
reviews.text: I have been taking my cars to Bridgewater Motorworks for the past several years and have always found the quality of service to be outstanding. I am very happy with their service, from major repairs and miscellaneous repairs to clearing fogged headlights on my son's jeep and replacing brakes and tires on the cars. The front office staff and mechanics have always been attentive and courteous, and the service is quick and reliable. I always highly recommend them to my family and friends.

reviews.author: judy lopes
reviews.text: The gentleman “T” answered the phone in the second ring, I explained I needed to replace my battery for my Mercedes. From that point on it was a very easy customer experience. I had no surprises and the work was done the same say. Because T made it so easy I didn't shop around I decided to go with Bridgewater Motorworks.

reviews.author: Jim Basiluk
reviews.text: Simply the best of the best. I brought my car to several mechanics and they couldn't resolve my check engine light issue but Paul and his team were able to find and fix the issue the first time. Paul is a great mechanic: humble, attentive, considerate, detailed with his work, and thorough with any issues you're having with your car. Just the best.

reviews.author: Brandon Velloso
reviews.text: Blown away by the customer service. Took my car in as I thought the starter had gone. Staff was polite and prompt, and even on Dec 23rd made sure to have my car ready asap. 31 point inspection was done and even received an email with detailed pictures pointing out anything that should be replaced/fixed in the near future. Will 100% be coming back for all future services and would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a fast, honest, and thorough mechanic.

reviews.author: William Gude
reviews.text: I have been taking my cars to Bridgewater Motorworks for several years for routine maintenance and repairs when necessary. They are professional, courteous and knowledgeable. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Chi Chi
reviews.text: I rarely write reviews but I have been coming to these guys for years and years with multiple cars. Every time I go in for an oil change it feels like family there. They constantly update you on what's going on with you car during your visit. It was my recent visit that provoked me to actually . I had come in for my oil change and I knew I was in need of some brakes. I went in the beginning of my day and expected to be there a couple hours for the services I needed done. When I asked how long the service will take I was told all day because of them being a little short staffed at the moment. I told them I'd come back another day because I had a whole day of errands planned. Then after a small chat I was told that I could be done within a couple hours. They put every man on my car and had me out of there in under two hours. I ended up needing and oil change, new filter and brake pads and rotors. They also patched a hole in my tire for me. I always feel like they guys take care of me. They are truly my go to and I always recommend them when I hear a friend needs some work done on their car and need a mechanic to trust. LOVE these guys!

reviews.author: manoj Menon
reviews.text: Excellent reliable service! Recently when my car battery died I searched for a good car repair shop and came to Bridgewater Motorworks. They were very professional and thorough in their estimates. During office hours I could always get someone at the other end of the line. Work was very satisfactory and work estimates were given up front. There were no surprises later on. I will recommend any one to this shop and use them for any of my future needs.

reviews.author: june stryshak
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about Bridgewater Motorworks! I have been using them for years and they have never let me down. When you walk in, you feel as if they know you more than just a face. They are professional, up front and get the job done! Even when your in a pinch. I have had everything from oils changes to major work done on my truck and I have never been more satisfied! My truck is my daily driver as well as my off road vehicle and it gets used hard and the team always makes sure she’s in top shape for what ever driving I will be doing! Keep up the great job guys!

reviews.author: David Justus
reviews.text: Bridgewater Motorworks knows what they are talking about ... it started with my no-appointment oil change and tire rotation. I was in and out. Then, when I needed my headlights fixed (not just replaced), they were able to solve the mystery that no one else seemed to be able to fix. Greg and his team have been very friendly and helpful. I would highly recommend them because they know what they are doing.

reviews.author: David Clark
reviews.text: From oil changes to new set of tires and everything in between, we use and trust and recommend Bridgewater MotorWorks. My wife has a Mini, side note they are Mini experts!

reviews.author: Marc
reviews.text: I had my 2019 civic si engine replaced last month by Bridgewater motor works and they did a fantastic job, driving around you would never think it wasn't the original engine. They serviced me well and got me a lower milage engine than when I bought the car originally and they were fast at getting it done, my only gripe is the warrenty.. 100 days is what they offered when other shops offered 3 years 60000 miles. I don't think 100 days is enough time for piece of mind but that aside the work was fantastic and the car is still running like nothing happened.. thank you Bridgewater motor works, keep your mechanics happy, there great and maybe you can give better warrenty options in the future.. piece of mind is important

reviews.author: Ilya Polovets
reviews.text: All the five star reviews here are true. They treat you like family when you walk the door. Took me in as a last minute oil change and ran me through exactly what will be done with the car and answered all of my questions clearly. But best of all is the efficiency and professionalism of the establishment. When you leave your car with them in confident you'll feel it is in good hands.

reviews.author: Anthony Nocerino
reviews.text: Moving from my previous mechanic in Morristown I was very picky for who I would be bringing my car to next; finding a mechanic you can trust nowadays is tough. I can happily say that each time I've been to Bridgewater Motorworks (I believe ~4 different times now) each experience has been fantastic and I've been blown away by their quality of service. The team there is professional, knowledgeable, and easy to talk to even if you aren't "mechanically inclined." If you're on the fence then give them a try with an oil change and you'll see what all the hype is :)

reviews.author: Joseph Clawson
reviews.text: I took my 10-year-old SUV to the dealer to resolve an oil leak and I couldn't believe how much they were going to charge. I thought I'd give Bridgewater motor works a try and they came up with an innovative approach that save me big bucks. They were very polite and explained everything they were going to do and I will continue to go back to Bridgewater motor works in the future highly recommended.

reviews.author: Heart Kitchens
reviews.text: Bridgewater Motorworks has been our exclusive mechanic for a number of years. From oil changes to more extensive repairs and tires, service has always been fast, accurate and responsibly priced. One mark of a great service business is employee retention. When we visit Bridgewater MW, the same, smiling faces are always behind the counter and in the shop. They know our vehicles and they know us. We won't trust our vehicles to any other shop.

reviews.author: Michael Marhoefer
reviews.text: This is a great mechanic. I live in Bernardsville but trust these guys enough to drive 30 min through morning I-287 traffic on a weekday. Service is professional and courteous. They don't go fishing for problems and are honest with what needs to be fixed. My girlfriend and I have taken my Civic and her Subaru here for years and have never been disappointed. Would definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: Kurt Matthews
reviews.text: Bridgewater Motorworks is outstanding. They made me feel very comfortable and I trust them with my car. The staff is courtesy, friendly, and didn’t talk over my head. They sent emails letting me know what stage of the repair process my car was at and when I could expect it to be done. I highly recommend Bridgewater Motor Works, and will be bringing my cars there in the future.

reviews.author: Jason Salerno
reviews.text: Great experiences here servicing my A4 and Highlander. Staff is very friendly and knowledgeable and goes out of their way to meet my needs. The owner even gave me a lift to work one day. Work product has been good - oil changes, brakes/rotors, maintenance. I'm glad I started using this shop.

reviews.author: Sincere Jackson
reviews.text: I took my car to this place expecting good treatment but all they did were create more problems. They told me to come pick up my car and this guy Greg tells me a different price then what he said over the phone. Once I get it and drive for a few days the problem comes right back. I take it back to them and they try to make me pay extra when I already paid and it’s the same problem. By the way people this is now, not a past story. I have to take my car back now. I wonder what they gonna try to charge me now when I Paid already and Leo em should be fixed.

reviews.author: Ed Vallejo
reviews.text: Had a transmission leak and was down the street from this garage. Very professional operation from when you first walk in the door. They perform a comprehensive inspection and let you know what services need to be done to your vehicle. Diagnosed and fixed my problem within a a couple days. Will definitely return if my transmission or engine act up again! Brough vehicle back a second time and they continue to do an outstanding job. They are an asset to the area. I am definitely a fan.

reviews.author: Francis Picc
reviews.text: Saved me $800 compared to the dealership. Need a new flex pipe and resonator. Same day service! Dropped it off at 830, got a ride home from the mechanic who drove it back, picked it up at 430. Easy in and out and the car sounds like brand new.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Barone
reviews.text: I always take my cars here for oil changes. The oil change is always done very quickly and at a great price. I love that there are places near by to have lunch in case I don't want to wait. However, the waiting area is comfy and relaxing. They always have a variety of magazines, and I absolutely LOVE the coffee selection. I choose to get my oil changes here because of the atmosphere and friendliness of the staff and especially the quality of service.

reviews.author: Vijay Thomas
reviews.text: Since the first time I brought my car here, I have witnessed amazing customer service, good pricing, and a genuine knowledge of cars and trucks. Once when I was out of town and got stuck, the staff there were able to help price check an issue I was facing. This is definitely a place I recommend.

reviews.author: Linda Salernitano
reviews.text: My husband brought his car here for a single bearing to be replaced and when we got the bill we totally felt taken advantage of. I called my Chevy dealer and they told me that a single bearing would not have costed $491 just for the part. Chevy said the part would've been tops $135 for top of the line .when I called and spoke to an employee to discuss the issue they told me it was inflation. If it was inflation my dealer would've charged that price as well but I truly see we were taken advantage of and the honorable thing to do would've been to credit us back some of the money that was unjustifiably charged. I will never use this company again. The word inflation was used too loosely especially when the dealership would've gotten the name brand part for a third of the price we were charged.

reviews.author: annisa carter
reviews.text: BEWARE OF PRICE GOUGING! SAVE $2000 ++ I was charged $191.90 for a diagnostic and was denied service. When I arrived I had a VTM-4 light on. I was informed that when a diagnostic test is done the price paid would be to applied to the final charges. Although 190 was steep for a diagnostic I agree based on the charge being taken off the final cost of service. Diagnostic results: Spark plug, AIR Intake hose, EGR, inner tire rod. Service to be completed: Valve lifter lash adjusting Remove and replace air intake house Clean carbon deposits at the EGR Replace tire rod Test wheele alignment Remove spark plug . Total Cost: 3,359.79 I then went went to TW service llc in Plainfield. No charge for diagnostic Diagnostic test read/ work received Clean carbon deposits at the EGR Valve lifter lash adjusting *****Total 314.55 My light is now off and car has been running fine for 3 days. Bridgewater Motors was rude and added unnecessary work in order to pad the bill. They just wanted to make 190 on a diagnostic and exaggerated service needs in order to make completion impossible. They needed to keep the car for 3-4 days And refused to divide work based priority I asked what was most important and what could be done now saved for later based on economics. They refused and stared it all had to be done at one time. They would not even top off my transmission fluid or do anything to compensate the 190 diagnostic. I requested the hose be changed and the said could take up to a week for the part to come in. After trying to reason with them I finally was defeated with no service received. The second shop completed the work in 4 hours. Please do not go here save your money and beware of shops that take advantage of women.

reviews.author: Jolanta Maziarz
reviews.text: After being taken for a ride by the dealerships, I finally found Bridgewater Motorworks and I'll never go anywhere else with my cars. My recent repair visit exceeded my expectations, but that is not unusual for this shop. The staff explained the problem, the process, the parts that were going to be replaced, the length of time it would take, and the price. No surprises. The repairs were completed ahead of schedule, using quality parts, for the price quoted. My car drives like a dream (again). The staff is professional and knowledgeable and the Owner, Greg, is one of the most honest people in the business. The level of service and the prices beat the dealership, in my experience, and the staff does not push unnecessary or premature services. I highly recommend Bridgewater Motorworks not only for major repairs but for routine service visits, as well.

reviews.author: Marcus M
reviews.text: The pun alone is worth 5 stars! I called into Bridgewater motorworks because the check engine light came on in my Audi s5 and Bill was able to take the car in the same day which was convenient-I was expecting to have to wait a week or so like I usually do when I bring my A6 to the dealership for service. Greg, Bill and Bryan were very receptive and Bryan who diagnosed and repaired the car was very thorough and I knew I was in good hands. They even went so far as to clean the leaves out of the trunk and engine bay which was on my to do list before I start putting my car cover on for the season. I’ll probably be taking both my cars here going forward. I wanted to wait until the rain stopped this week (the repairs were completed on Thursday) to take the S5 out and see how the repairs went before I typed a review and I just got back from about 100 miles of driving and the car runs as smooth as the day I got it. I had only intended to do a quick 20 miles but I just kept cruising until I got pulled over and let off with a warning it felt that good to have the car back!

reviews.author: Dallas Taylor
reviews.text: Avoid wasting your time at Bridgewater Motoworks. My car had a clicking noise coming from the front right axle, so my partner took it to the mechanic. The owner provided a quote of $575.78 and diagnosed the problem as a right front differential issue. After picking up the car, I still heard the clicking noise. A few days later, we returned because the sound persisted. This time, Greg gave us a quote of $1000, stating that the right front axle needed to be replaced. I was initially confused because why wasn't this axle issue mentioned when the differential problem was addressed earlier? Seeking clarification, my partner visited the business, only to be met with Greg's condescending and disrespectful attitude. This company doesn't deserve any stars whatsoever. I highly recommend that everyone avoids them, as they are clearly exploiting their customers.

reviews.author: Sean O'Brien
reviews.text: I’ve used Bridgewater Motorworks for both of our family vehicles and each time we are continually impressed. The staff is friendly, they always walk you through what needs to be done on the vehicle and are honest. I highly recommend them to anyone in need of repairs or just standard maintenance!

reviews.author: lisa gilmurray
reviews.text: I had my front brakes replaced and some other things done to my Expedition at Bridgewater Motor Works. They were great, efficient, fast and really nice to work with!

reviews.author: Susan Jones
reviews.text: I have taken several of my cars to Bridgewater Motorworks and consistently the repairs and maintenance have been outstanding. The staff treats you kindly from start to finish. I will continue to get all my cars serviced by BMs. Nice to have a shop you can trust and have confidence in.

reviews.author: Stan Spilecki
reviews.text: I'm traveling and my catalytic converter was stolen from my car. I have to be on the road tomorrow morning early so needed to get it fixed today. Not only did they work me in but they did an obviously professional job at a price that was more than reasonable. Online estimates were much higher. They even vacuumed!

reviews.author: David Houser
reviews.text: Outstanding service, Greg the owner said you will have your car back following day by lunch time. Motorworks call at 11 am. My car was fixed, ready for pickup. They are great!

reviews.author: Steven Beebe
reviews.text: Prompt attention, quality work, very fair pricing, excellent service and communication before, during, and after the sale. Highly recommend. This latest project was an old BMW all beat up on the sides and they made it look great again!

reviews.author: Patricia Bishop
reviews.text: Nothing but good experiences with all our cars. Took car there due to error code stating major repair but this shop found and repaired the issue without doing major repair. Definitely recommend using Bridgewater Motorworks.

reviews.author: Russell Tenzer
reviews.text: Great service! T at the counter was super helpful in keeping me informed in what work was being done on my work van. Great vibes and atmosphere all around. Quick and great work!

reviews.author: Sam Murphy
reviews.text: I’ve been going to Bridgewater Motorworks for several years, and always have a good experience. They are honest, efficient and reputable. Their customer service is excellent (especially their friendly dog!), and they always provide prompt service. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Robert Fisher
reviews.text: Engine replacement was recommended and shop was able to obtain and install a low mileage used engine. Shop did a professional job with the installation. Warranty is 6 months with unlimited mileage. The shop does quality work.

reviews.author: The Landing Information
reviews.text: Very professional, friendly staff. Had my car back within 24 hours, without any problems. Great prices. Staff followed up to make sure everything was running smoothly. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Kool Pig
reviews.text: Excellent service, they return all of my calls, honored all of the warranted work, made arrangements for towing. They even cleaned the car after fixing it, The owner also made a follow up call to see every thing was to my satisfaction.

reviews.author: Alex Kaplan
reviews.text: Very friendly and efficient. When I showed up as a walk in with an unexpected problem, they took me right away. I got a diagnosis within minutes and they worked diligently to have me on my way as soon as they could. I find their pricing to be a little more than usual, but I’d rather spend the extra money to have it done right.

reviews.author: Sung Yun Lee
reviews.text: Prompt, excellent follow up, and great customer service! Was strongly recommend anyone around the Bridgewater area to check this place out!

reviews.author: Pina Hoel
reviews.text: My wife went to BW Motorworks to have our Subaru checked out as something seemed off with the transmission. They took the time to find the leak in the line and verified that the transmission was still okay. They were so honest and friendly. We will be back.

reviews.author: MrBmatt9
reviews.text: I've had dealings with Bridgewater Motorworks for over 20 years. I manage a large fleet repair shop and when my fleet customers need service in Central Jersey there is no place better for me to send them. Prompt, efficient and quality service every time.

reviews.author: BandBMatt Matthey
reviews.text: As the manager of a large fleet repair shop in South Jersey I fully trust Bridgewater Motorworks to service our customers when they are in Central Jersey on our behalf. I've known them now for over 20 years. Excellent service and integrity.

reviews.author: Thomas Columbia
reviews.text: I have had multiple cars serviced at Bridgewater Motor Works. They are always courteous and thorough with their explanations. I have also recommended some of my friends to go there and they have been very satisfied. We will continue to use Bridgewater Motor Works!

reviews.author: Kristin Sloane
reviews.text: Always reliable and trustworthy. Went recently for an oil change and minor concern which was resolved quickly. husband and I have been bringing our cars here for years.

reviews.author: Stephen Lavender
reviews.text: I had front and rear brakes and rotors done here. First class facility, first class service, first class workmanship. Getting a lift into New Brunswick by the owner himself in a luxary SUV and a personal phone call from him after the work was completed was a 5-star touch!

reviews.author: Jaleel Hatcher
reviews.text: Great place to get work done on your vehicle. Staff was very professional and open about all work that needed to be completed. Will definitely be going back in the future.

reviews.author: Adam Boxell
reviews.text: I had the unfortunate circumstances of breaking down at 4 am during a snow storm. After leaving a message, Greg called me back before the shop even opened. We made arrangements to get my car fixed that day. Greg and his team are true professionals who get the job done right the first time. I will absolutely use them again!

reviews.author: Jean S
reviews.text: very friendly, professional staff who repaired my vehicle quickly and kept me informed of progress. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Alfredo Caro (Al)
reviews.text: Recently (8 Dec) had some major engine work done on my 2011 Subaru WRX. Bill Finn and his team successfully brought the car back to live for the next 80k miles. I've had air con services also performed by Bridgewater Motorworks I the spring and the a/c has been working like new.

reviews.author: Katherine Gray
reviews.text: I had my car towed to Motorworks on a Thursday night . The staff and owner were awesome. The owner called the next day and my car was ready by the following Thursday. The service was great! Thank you.

reviews.author: Luis B
reviews.text: I go here pretty often, it's a very customer service oriented shop. They're extremely friendly and offer free wifi, candy, and water bottles, and are definitely very organized. It's totally unlike most places I go to, where it's very stiff and unwelcoming, totally great people who've never let me down.

reviews.author: Kolby V.
reviews.text: Had original transmission rebuilt. Daily driver to and from work. Transmission failed within 13 months. They only gave me a 12 month warranty. Wouldn’t offer any discount for repair or replacement.

reviews.author: Dave Watson
reviews.text: On my visit to Motorworks I noticed right away the customer service attitude was positive and interested in my concerns. I met Greg, the owner and found him to be knowledgeable and helpful. Clean, efficient and fairly priced.

reviews.author: Tony Giralo
reviews.text: I take all my cars to Bridgewater Motorworks for service. The Team is excellent and the service is always professional. Everyone is very knowledgeable and they keep my cars running top notch.

reviews.author: Teon Wang
reviews.text: Over rated shop low star to balance it. Need a n alternator replacement for $1000 quote I RAN. Bought one myself $150 put it on myself. If you don’t know anything about cars DO NOT COME HERE! Search YouTube for instructions on your specific car.

reviews.author: John Costin
reviews.text: A very customer-focused service experience. They kept me updated on what was going on with my vehicle and gave me various options on how to take care of the problem. I will definitely do business here again.

reviews.author: Richard Salem
reviews.text: When my airbag warning light came on in my 2001 Audi TT, there was only one place to go for help - Bridgewater Motorworks. An expert staff diagnosed the issued and made the necessary repairs effectively and efficiently, getting me back on the open road ASAP. These are car experts you can trust.

reviews.author: Alicia Whittaker
reviews.text: Accommodated a same day, short notice appointment and got me right in. They worked on my car. Did a good job and were very friendly! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Ron Marshall
reviews.text: Best experience by far. I never had an engine replaced, just normally traded the cars in. But when my daughter's Jeep Wrangler engine died I took a chance and glad I did.

reviews.author: Margaret Reis
reviews.text: The people who work there have been so kind and great with me. They took the time in explaining what needed to be done and what was going on with my Jeep. I will definitely be going there instead of the dealership for everything going forward.

reviews.author: Terry LaForme
reviews.text: Great people, helped arrange a tow to their shop and speedy repair to get me back on the road. 5 stars

reviews.author: Brianna Mae
reviews.text: Best technicians around, always high quality work in a reasonable amount of time. Also they have 4 legged employees, go get your oil changed and play with Maddie and Molly and you'll see why this place is the best!

reviews.author: Doc Rads
reviews.text: Great work,friendly service. No gimmicks or forcement,just straight up honesty for any automotive work including oil changes or tire rotations

reviews.author: Michael Campbell
reviews.text: Excellent experience! Everyone was very helpful and service technition found an issue with my transmission and recommended I get it fix by the dealer as the car was still under warranty.

reviews.author: Josh Espinoza
reviews.text: I took my car in for an electrical and steering wheel problem, they quickly addressed the issue and I was on the road with my car the following day. They were nice and pleasant to talk to

reviews.author: Brooklyn’s Own
reviews.text: Took a half-day off work to go and get an oil change. The office was clean, and the staff was friendly. I was in-and-out in less than an hour, and the price was fair. I will be using them again.

reviews.author: Bob Lefever
reviews.text: Everything that was supposed to be done was done in good time. I picked my car up after hours and that was convenient for me. The repair fixed my car's problem so I am satisfied. Thanks for the popcorn also.

reviews.author: Julie Sharma
reviews.text: 5 stars-Staff are knowledgeable and honest and though it might look like a simple shop, their service was above and beyond that of most shops. On top of that, they support several outreach projects in the community- bravo!

reviews.author: Joseph Spera
reviews.text: Having seven vehicles on the road, that's where they have to stay. Greg and his crew get my trucks back on the road quick and reasonably priced, sometimes for a quick oil change, tire, or major repairs I can depend on them Thanks Spera Electric LLC

reviews.author: Jeff Hoffmann
reviews.text: Greg and his team take care of my vehicles. It has taken a long time to find a mechanic that I like and trust. They have earned my highest recommendation.

reviews.author: Ed Rebenack
reviews.text: I recently had some repair work done at Bridgewater Motorworks. The staff was very accommodating, the work was done on time and overall it was a great experience. I would recommend to anyone in need of service work.

reviews.author: Donald Gill
reviews.text: Bridgewater Motorworks provides an exceptional customer experience as well as quality parts and service provider. Transportation was provided to and from the store at no charge, and my car is running perfectly.

reviews.author: Bill Nada
reviews.text: Great guys. I've had work from the before and it was great service. Even when they couldn't address my specific A/C problem another time they knew exactly who to refer me to, and he was great.

reviews.author: jeanette walker
reviews.text: I had to get to Pennsylvania to visit my dad and one of tirewell of the front tire was just flapping in the wind. I was scared to drive. I urgently went there and they took care of it in a jiffy. Thank you

reviews.author: Rhea Canares
reviews.text: All the times I have been here to get my car and the husband's car serviced, we are always met by their excellent staff. Friendly and effecient service!

reviews.author: ameal b
reviews.text: Came to them twice to do some work in the Subaru. They're very straightforward and easy to work with and they've even take their time to update me in their work.

reviews.author: Kyle Newell
reviews.text: If you are looking to be treated incredibly fairly by the staff and want top of the line auto care, then BW Motor Works is the place to go. My wife and I have been going here for years. Check it out!

reviews.author: runjkid
reviews.text: I was referred here by AAA and will continue to come back here in the future. I was greatly pleased by their customer service, including insightful explanations of the services that would be performed on my vehicle.

reviews.author: Tiffany Ovadia
reviews.text: They were so kind and so informative. Definitely will go there again. Very much appreciated there knowledge kindness and was not overpriced

reviews.author: Kyle Buonocore
reviews.text: Very professional. All the people there are really nice. They get my vehicles back on the road quick with the job done right the first time.

reviews.author: Rooster Farian
reviews.text: They are one of the few mechanics that don't try and rip you off and sell you services that you don't need. Additionally, they offer you rides to and from the shop, so that you don't have to sit and wait all day.

reviews.author: Ray Birring
reviews.text: Best shop in the area. Very friendly and professional staff. I always know my vehicle is in good hands when I leave it with them.
